## Review findings

- **[P1] Benchmark sanitization leaves unsanitized FTS indexes searchable.** [run.py](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/benchmarks/agent-brain/run.py:1941) rewrites JSON, JSONL, Markdown, and text files but never removes or rebuilds `history/index-fts.sqlite` or `docs/index-fts.sqlite`. Their fingerprints only use generation time and record count ([doc_fts.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/doc_fts.go:43), [history_fts.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/history_fts.go:79)), so content-only redactions still appear fresh. Brain searches can therefore retrieve benchmark scaffolding or hidden material that sanitization supposedly removed. Invalidate or rebuild both indexes after sanitization.

- **[P1] Mutable semantic databases are opened with SQLite’s `immutable=1`.** [sqlite_read.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/sqlite_read.go:11) applies `immutable=1` to semantic read connections, while runtime trace ingestion writes to that same WAL database in [semantic_graph.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/semantic_graph.go:976). SQLite explicitly warns that immutable databases must not change and otherwise may return incorrect results or `SQLITE_CORRUPT` ([SQLite URI documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/uri.html)). Use `mode=ro` without `immutable` for the mutable semantic store, or separate mutable runtime traces from immutable generated indexes.

- **[P2] Agent retries reuse partial edits while auditing only the final attempt.** [run.py](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/benchmarks/agent-brain/run.py:4762) reruns a transiently failed agent in the same worktree without restoring the prepared baseline. It then calculates usage/activity from only the last process, and the leak audit reads only `agent.stdout`/`agent.stderr` at [run.py](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/benchmarks/agent-brain/run.py:5929). Earlier attempts can therefore modify the solution, consume unreported tokens, or use forbidden material without appearing in the final audit. Aggregate every attempt’s evidence, and either restore the baseline or explicitly treat retries as a continued run.

- **[P2] `brain_refresh` drops its worktree setting for semantic indexing.** The MCP tool defaults `worktree=true`, but [mcp.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/mcp.go:511) only sets `refreshOpts.seed.worktree`; it never sets `refreshOpts.semanticWorktree`. Consequently, `brain_refresh {"semantic":true}` fails on a dirty repository because [semantic.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/semantic.go:427) refuses the semantic rebuild without worktree mode. This contradicts the tool’s advertised worktree contract.

- **[P2] `inspect changes` is documented as read-only but writes by default.** [agent_surface.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/agent_surface.go:904) initializes `persist: true` and registers `--write-report` with a `true` default. The [README](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/README.md:364) and [semantic guide](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/docs/semantic_agent_guide.md:36) say the command is read-only unless that flag is added. Either change the default to false or document `--write-report=false` as the read-only form.

- **[P2] Semantic history retrieval bypasses self-echo filtering.** [retrieve.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/retrieve.go:147) filters tool-call echoes from lexical history results, but vector and hybrid semantic results are appended unfiltered at [retrieve.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-brain/internal/cli/retrieve.go:163). With a history embedder enabled, prior Brain query echoes can return through the semantic arm. Apply the same filter to both semantic rank lists.
